stem: Which Texas land formation is correctly paired with the force that made the land formation?

options.label: F
options.text: A canyon at Palo Duro Canyon State Park was formed by a river.

options.label: G
options.text: A sand dune at Monahans Sandhills State Park was formed by an earthquake.

options.label: H
options.text: A delta at the end of the Guadalupe River was formed by wind.

options.label: J
options.text: A rock formation with layers on Mustang Island was formed by ice.
